title: Artifact-centered Claim-aware Observability for Autonomous Scientific Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.18312v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Autonomous scientific agents now increasingly propose ideas, write code, run experiments, analyze results, and even draft papers. Observe and audit those agents are necessary but logging every model call is not enough, scientists also need to inspect the artifacts and claims that the systems produced and their relations. This is driven by the fact that failures in scientific agent systems are often distributed across several objects. A manuscript claim may cite the wrong evidence, a search process may select a degenerate candidate, a laboratory novelty claim may depend on an unstated rule, or a multi-agent plan may change without a visible trigger. Existing tracing, experiment tracking, and archival provenance tools are valuable, but their native objects do not make these scientific audit relations first-class. translated_title: 面向自主科学智能体的以工件为中心、主张感知的可观测性
translated_abstract: 自主科学智能体如今越来越多地提出想法、编写代码、运行实验、分析结果，甚至起草论文。观察和审计这些智能体是必要的，但仅记录每次模型调用并不足够，科学家还需要检查系统生成的工件和主张及其相互关系。这是因为科学智能体系统中的失败往往分布在多个对象之间。一个手稿主张可能引用错误的证据，一个搜索过程可能选择退化的候选方案，一个实验室新颖性主张可能依赖于未明示的规则，或者一个多智能体计划可能在无可见触发的情况下发生变化。现有的追踪、实验记录和归档溯源工具很有价值，但其原生对象并未将这些科学审计关系视为一等公民。我们认为，自主科学系统应输出可移植的、主张感知的工件谱系，作为最低审计层。我们提出...
tldr: 本文提出自主科学智能体应输出可移植的、主张感知的工件谱系作为最低审计层，以解决现有工具无法将科学审计关系作为一等公民的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes that autonomous scientific agents should emit portable, claim-aware artifact lineage as a minimum audit layer, addressing the gap where existing tools fail to treat scientific audit relations as first-class.
